author: raymond91125
body:
Dear all, 

The proposal has been made to obsolete GO:0016002 sulfite reductase activity
see https://github.com/geneontology/go-ontology/issues/31518

=> there are 8 direct EXP annotations, all to M. tuberculosis 'sir' (P9WJ03)
=> UniProt annotates P9WJ03 to EC:1.8.7.1 = GO:0050311 sulfite reductase (ferredoxin) activity (which ironically, isn't a child of GO:0016002.)

Experimental annotations that need to be reviewed are here: 
https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/135XGwNTy-vqjGCI8acWeAvdJMMisvOl4L_O2cfQeYKM/edit?gid=0#gid=0

Impacted groups: 
CACAO 1
MTBBASE 2
TAIR 2
UniProt 2

** Group contacts: https://github.com/geneontology/go-site/blob/master/metadata/group-contacts.csv
----

Mappings that need to be reviewed: (InterPro2GO, UniProt-Keywords, UniRule) 

GO:0016002	hamap2go	HAMAP:MF_02023 > GO:sulfite reductase activity ; GO:0016002
GO:0016002	interpro2go	InterPro:IPR032897 Dissimilatory sulfite reductase > GO:sulfite reductase activity ; GO:0016002
GO:0016002	unirule2go	UniRule:UR000165756 > GO:sulfite reductase activity ; GO:0016002



Thanks.
title: Review annotations to GO:0016002 sulfite reductase activity

author: Antonialock
body:
I don't think all direct annotations are to M. tuberculosis 'sir' (P9WJ03), see quickgo:
https://www.ebi.ac.uk/QuickGO/annotations?goUsage=exact&goUsageRelationships=is_a,part_of,occurs_in&goId=GO:0016002&evidenceCode=ECO:0000269&evidenceCodeUsage=descendants

uniprot and mtbbase done

author: sjm41
body:
> I don't think all direct annotations are to M. tuberculosis 'sir' (P9WJ03), 

Sorry, you're right @Antonialock !
After fixing theUP and mtbbase annotations, the 3 emaining EXP annotations are:

- arabidopsis SIR by TAIR from PMID:23221833 and PMID:9661674 -> UP annotates this to RHEA:23132 (= GO:0050311 sulfite reductase (ferredoxin) activity) from PMID:9661674, so suggest change to that.

- Streptomyces SCO6102 (Q9ADG1) by CACAO from PMID:22659143 -> UP annotates this to EC:1.8.7.1 (= GO:0050311 sulfite reductase (ferredoxin) activity), so suggest change to that.
